extracted.intended_audience: general public; educators, students, and anyone interested in peer review and growth mindset
extracted.subtask_description: A short TEDxYouth talk introducing the importance of peer reviews in everyday life and advocating applying a growth mindset to peer feedback to achieve outcomes beyond mere technical excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Importance of peer reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover the importance of peer reviews in our everyday life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The talk frames peer review as an everyday practice worth cultivating; evaluate whether peer review is positioned as a routine part of learning and working and whether its broader value (beyond error-catching) is communicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of growth mindset in peer reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Using growth mindset in those peer reviews can lead to far more than just excellent work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes adopting a growth mindset when giving/receiving peer feedback. Assessment should consider whether feedback promotes learning, improvement, and development (not just judgement), and whether the talk gives examples or rationale showing outcomes beyond mere product quality.
